svg.aria-label: Constructed Hertz contact data for a 1 μm sphere, 20 kPa specimen and Poisson ratio 0.45. A shows noisy observations and fit; B gives residuals; C holds the curve fixed while changing assumed probe radius, revealing the relationship between geometry calibration and modulus.
